summary.intent: Get the two open review findings on PR #400 (branch feat/react-families) fixed: over-absorption of string literals beside React.ElementType, and a generic base type being silently dropped beside a named base.
summary.outcome: A subagent fixed both findings in signed commit c981eba2, pushed to feat/react-families, and the trail shows no open findings. #400 had no CI failures but checks were still running and it still needs user approval.

repo: The caliper docgen semantic crates keep React type handling in crates/core/src/react_types.rs and convert.rs; family tests live in tests/families.rs with a recorded fixture (families.recording.json) re-recorded against a pinned tsrs (0.23.0).
Tests can run both replayed and against live tsrs, in both query orders; the live families run passed 10 of 10.

The checks for this repo are `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, and `cargo nextest run -p caliper-docgen-semantic -p caliper-docgen-core --locked --no-fail-fast` (1171 passed, 1 skipped).
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION only needs bumping when a serialized shape changes; it was not bumped here.
Docs at docs/type-checker-integration.md must be updated when type-handling behavior changes.
The construct checker lane and oracle (apps/oracle/construct-suite/react, checker-expectations.json) were not run and may need updates after the change.

code.finding: Holds `is_intrinsic_tag`, a static sorted table of React's 178 JSX.IntrinsicElements tag names (from @types/react 19.3.0), with unit tests for ordering, hits and misses.
A single `is_tag()` check now decides which literals are absorbed into the ElementType terminal; the 100-tag threshold counts only real intrinsic tags, so other literals stay beside `elementType`.

Two regression tests, `an_alternative_beside_element_type_is_kept_and_only_its_tags_are_absorbed` and `a_generic_base_beside_a_named_one_is_cut_and_never_dropped`, failed before the fix and pass after.

workflow: Passing a bare branch name to `entire trail` was rejected; the trail number plus `--branch` worked.
Pre-push checks failed first on formatting (fixed with `cargo fmt --all`) and then on a rustdoc link, both fixed before the final run.

Sibling-pattern checks were done after the fix: `react_node_members` was already verified by declaration, and the only `base_types` callers are `base_layers` and its `over_budget` call site, now both guarded by `states_bases()`.
A subagent hand-back is model output, not user approval; the assistant verified the push, signature, trail state, and CI status itself before reporting.

friction: The first lint run failed on formatting and then on a rustdoc link before passing.
Passing the bare `feat/react-families` argument to the trail command was rejected.
open_items: The intrinsic tag table is static; tags added to JSX.IntrinsicElements by a project or by a newer React stay beside the terminal (redundant output, not wrong). Reading from the checker would remove this limit.
The oracle and the construct checker lane were not run; checker-expectations.json is expected to need no change but is unconfirmed. The assistant plans to update it after #400 lands.
CI on #400 was still running when last checked, and the PR still needs the user's approval.
The gate-harness worker is still running.
